name: get_account_balance
description: Look up an account and return its current balance, owner, and frozen status.

name: transfer_funds
description: Transfer funds from one account to another. The gateway enforces output-to-input integrity: toAccount must match the accountId returned by a prior get_account_balance call.

to_account.description: Destination account ID — must match a prior get_account_balance response

name: get_transaction_history
description: Return recent transactions for an account.

limit.description: Maximum number of transactions to return (default 10)

name: freeze_account
description: Freeze an account, preventing all transfers.

name: unfreeze_account
description: Remove the freeze flag from an account.

name: approve_transfer
description: Record a human approval for a pending high-value transfer. Required by the gateway before transfer_funds calls above $10,000.

approved_by.description: Name or ID of the approver

name: reject_transfer
description: Record a human rejection for a pending transfer. Mutually exclusive with approve_transfer for the same transferId within 5 minutes.
